title: Ship retry router: a DETERMINISTIC stage refusal (same refused pathspec twice) stops retrying in place and routes to continuation
problem: Residual of continuation-worktree-base-refresh (the base-advance heal landed console-side; this is its acceptance item 3). GIT_STAGE_FAILED is always classified transient, so a deterministic pathspec refusal (cycle-1365: same .evolve/evals path refused twice) burns the whole retry budget on an unwinnable add. The base-advance removes the dominant cause; this closes the class for any OTHER deterministic refusal.
fix: In the ship retry router, fingerprint the refused pathspec set; identical refusal on consecutive attempts => stop in-place retries, classify deterministic, route to the normal failure path (continuation/salvage). Connects to gitstage-deterministic-classification (0.74) — land together.
acceptance: A fixture ship whose add refuses the same pathspec twice stops retrying and classifies deterministic; a transient refusal (different error) still retries; wiring proof over the retry seam.
